full_name: Christia Mercer | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Humanities Mildred Londa Weisman Fellow Columbia University
bio: Christia Mercer is the Gustave M. Berne Professor of Philosophy at Columbia University, general editor of the Oxford Philosophical Concepts series, and coeditor of Oxford New Histories of Philosophy, a book series devoted to making philosophy more inclusive.
